findings.finding: The first submitted content failed the explicitly stated overshoot<5 percent requirement; subsequent reviewed contents pass this check.

The candidate computes TTC before rounding its continuous state, then writes ego speed, distance and TTC independently with six decimal places. The fixed suite recomputes TTC from the rounded CSV values using a1e-5 relative tolerance. Near zero closing speeds this magnifies input quantization. This is not evidence of a terminal or model transport adapter fault.

The public instruction requires distance steady-state error<2m but does not define a sample window. The suite averages the final100 follow/emergency samples; the candidate report instead averages final100 closing samples where TTC exists. The latter value does not establish fulfillment of the unrestricted public criterion. The suite window also includes emergency recovery and a rapidly changing lead speed, so it is not demonstrated to be a steady-state segment. This audit does not prove that the suite target is impossible.

candidate_window.criterion: last100 follow/emergency rows with defined TTC

findings.background_constraint: Following may accelerate toward set speed, but must not exceed set speed simply to close excess gap.

findings.finding: Later submission metadata marks the file preview as truncated. The independently checked snapshot directories nevertheless contain the simulation CSV, sensor CSV and report. This audit found no loss of these delivery files.

The public instruction describes counting flows whose reverse key exists; frozen background explicitly says to count forward/reverse pairs once, dividing the reverse-present flow count by2. Both the reviewed candidate and suite use the background pair convention. This is not evidence that the Verifier invented the convention. No hidden official expectation was inspected.

The public instruction and selected background require sorting packet timestamps before computing inter-arrival times. The reviewed suite appends timestamps in capture order and uses adjacent differences without sorting. The candidate does sort. Whether capture order differs on this particular input was not measured; this audit does not attribute the official failure to this gap.

Portscan and DoS flags are validated as booleans but their substantive classification is not checked. Benign consistency is only enforced when any malicious-pattern flag is true; the all-false case has no assertion. The beacon test asserts the current capture has CV>0.5 then requires False. The selected background supports0.5 as guidance, but the test remains tied to this capture rather than a general conditional classification. A13/13 suite result therefore does not prove all analysis flags satisfy the public task.
findings.not_claimed: These observations do not identify which hidden official check caused a completed negative oracle.

findings.finding: S2 retains the numerical statistics but strengthens the DoS heuristic with busiest-minute IPv4 volume and single-target concentration. On the submitted snapshot this changes DoS true to false and benign false to true. The reviewed V1 suite cannot discriminate these outcomes through its DoS check.

S0_comparison.finding: S0 consists of SKILL.md only; the sealed final contains SKILL.md and nine Python scripts. The learning loop materialized and revised a reusable implementation rather than only adjusting an existing initial script.

observed_changes.finding: io_utils, sim_core and the output-number format remain byte-identical to S4. Both core and generated standalone simulation still use six decimal places for CSV numbers.

generate_all now executes the generated standalone simulation.py as the authoritative producer. Exported PID adds integral clamping; validation compares CSV/report hashes against a fresh standalone rerun.

The tuner now first selects candidates satisfying its own published-metric predicates, then uses lexicographic ranking; noncompliant candidates use a fallback score. Its distance predicate still uses closing-only metrics, so this is not proof the fixed suite distance target is met.
Report rendering explicitly gives numerical values three decimal places and documents the closing-only distance-error convention.

addenda.suite_comparison_rule: Rates can be compared directly only within the same suite hash. V1 has13, V2 has43 and V3 has44 collected pytest cases; these are not assertion counts.

observed_content_changes.finding: SKILL.md adds an explicit importable Python invocation, and the writer/validator CLI bodies are extracted into reusable functions. The core packet metric implementation remains byte-identical.

The DoS classifier adds busy-minute IPv4 volume and single-target concentration conditions; public output DoS changes true to false and benign false to true. Normal official aggregate checks rise from11/14 to13/14, while valid official reward remains0. This observation does not identify a hidden test cause.

Port collection is moved before the IPv4 guard, broadening collection to TCP/UDP layers from packets previously excluded from port metrics. On the submitted capture unique source and destination ports each rise by1 and port entropy increases. V3 recomputation uses IPv4-scoped TCP/UDP values and rejects these changes. The diff does not explicitly invent a missing port0 or add ICMP dummy ports; this review does not resolve the public wording/background scope ambiguity or hidden official expectations.

Port-scan detection switches to SYN-attempt destination distributions and same-direction ACK-without-SYN handshake completion tracking. The public scan check begins failing; this is a visible disagreement with V3 converging-evidence classification, not proof of transport failure.

Beacon detection adds per-direction IP-pair interval analysis: median-centered regular intervals may set the flag even when global CV is not low. V3 uses the supplied global-CV guidance and rejects the resulting true flag on this snapshot.
Pair-beacon detection additionally requires at least3 reverse packets and reverse packet ratio>=0.25; the public beacon failure resolves, while port-scope and port-scan failures remain.

final_selection.selection_basis: Pinned author prioritizes a finite official reward and replaces the best snapshot only for a strictly greater reward. S1 and S2 both have valid reward0, so S2 partial-check improvement11/14→13/14 does not replace the earlier S1. The post-final oracle uses S1 and again reports11/14 with reward0.
final_selection.selection_is_not_independent_evaluation: No later independent evaluation was read or used for this selection audit.

interpretation_limits: Public surrogate growth from13 to43 cases is a suite upgrade, not measured progress on a fixed set of assertions.
A later public suite can disagree with a reasonable alternative interpretation of ambiguous public background; its verdict does not prove hidden official agreement.
No exact hidden grader failure is attributed here.
No new runtime/adapter defect is established by these content changes.
Independent fresh per-version evaluation is intentionally excluded and must be joined separately.
